intent.proves: At least one page, row or paragraph preset is saved.
intent.scope: non-deleted pages, rows and paragraphs flagged as presets

bindings.reason: No MCP tool lists content presets (get_item_presets covers item field-value presets, a different feature); Admin query name not verified.

bindings.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE PageIsTemplate = 1 AND PageDeleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GridRow WHERE GridRowIsTemplate = 1 AND GridRowDeleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Paragraph WHERE ParagraphIsTemplate = 1 AND ParagraphDeleted = 0)
